svg.aria-label: Four-step structure of the UK power system model: data and assumption processing, supply-demand balance modelling, daily dispatch simulation with a cost feedback loop, and outputs (an enlarged time-series chart plus a bullet-point summary of annual metrics, scenario search, and the teaching app). Each data/output panel is illustrated with a schematic fake-data chart showing the type of data, not real values.
